target: STEP English/NRSV references; TAHOT primary / TAGNT NA28 membership
rules: OT: standard English addresses, only in chapters whose numbered verse counts agree; Hebrew parenthetical references are not KJV references.
NT: parse each selected NA28 token's KJV square-bracket address in TAGNT. Unmarked tokens use their English/NRSV address.
A target verse spanning multiple KJV addresses retains each source address and marks partial correspondence; never treat as exact text alignment.
Psalm headings at verse 0 have no KJV numbered verse counterpart; keep unresolved until explicitly reviewed.
Missing source addresses and unverified chapter boundaries remain unresolved. No chronological inference from neighboring addresses.
